title: AI Zero Network Region Flow v0.4
description: Schema for directional observable flow between two Zero Network Regions during a bounded observation window.

flow_id.description: Unique identifier for this Region Flow observation.

source_region.description: Region from which the observed flow originated.

target_region.description: Region toward which the observed flow moved.

window_start.description: Inclusive start of the observation window.

window_end.description: End of the observation window. Semantic validation MUST confirm that it is later than window_start.

observation_state.description: Completeness state of this flow observation.

trace_count.description: Number of qualifying Trace transitions from source_region to target_region.

receipt_count.description: Number of qualifying externally effective actions associated with this directional flow.

message_count.description: Number of observable messages crossing from source_region to target_region.

tool_call_count.description: Number of observable tool calls crossing the regional boundary.

authority_transfer_count.description: Number of observable authority delegations or transfers associated with this directional flow.

tokens.description: Observable token volume associated with the directional flow.

cost.description: Observable implementation-defined cost associated with the directional flow.

compute_units.description: Observable compute volume associated with the directional flow.

method.description: Method used to derive the flow indicator.
